title: Malformed production-quality sidecars escape aggregate validation
reasoning: The production-quality branch assumes decoded JSON is a mapping with a hashable parser_tokenizer_schema_id. An empty object raises KeyError; null or an array raises TypeError; an array-valued ID also raises TypeError. These exceptions are outside the handler, so malformed durable evidence aborts finalization instead of returning canonical_artifact_invalid and publishing an ineligible generation.
reproduction: Pass _build_score_evidence a sidecar named problems/p/checkpoints/c/production_quality.json containing {}. It raises KeyError before returning eligibility.
recommendation: Validate the decoded production-quality shape and schema ID before collecting it, and convert malformed artifact failures into canonical_artifact_invalid.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests do not exercise scoring finalization or malformed producer sidecars.
suggestedRegressionTest: Cover malformed JSON shapes, missing required fields, and invalid schema-ID types across producer fragments; assert an ineligible result rather than an uncaught exception.
minimumFixScope: src/slop_code/metrics/scoring/finalization.py artifact parsing and focused finalization validation tests.
